description: An affordable, health-conscious facial serum formulated with 10% Niacinamide and 1% Zinc to help refine pores and reduce blemishes. It offers high-quality active ingredients at a budget-friendly price point, boasting a vegan, cruelty-free, and fragrance-free formula that supports clean skin health.
packaging: Frosted glass bottle equipped with a white dropper pipette featuring a metallic rose-gold collar
